subject: [cam] vcodecd asks from the Camera integration (not blocking)
body: The prod payload uses the current tree vcodecd (f974e33f, built 01:13, includes your restart-after-any-HEVC rule). P04 now handles your restart answer: StartSession retries OPEN/reconnect for 600 ms, the first-picture reopen for 1.5 s (needed: Camera sets bitrate after StartSession, so every HEVC recording reopens -> one restart per HEVC session; H.264 reopen stays in-process). Requests: (1) HELLO_OK.reserved busy bits (bit0 encoder session open, bit1 decoder open) so the decoder plug-in can refuse in CreateInstance instead of failing StartSession (VT does not retry decoder StartSession); (2) vcodecd.log has no size limit under KeepAlive (phases line every 10th picture): truncate stdout at start when > 4 MB?; (3) --session-idle-ms 10000 stays (P04 reopens if its StartSession OPEN is older than 8 s). Please keep OPEN level 0 = auto and OPEN carrying bitrate/fps/gop/profile: P04 depends on it.
